thread:
maria: Quick design request — we need a lightweight "benchmark kit" for the small-business launch. Goal: one-page asset bundle for sales + three social hero visuals + one technical diagram + webinar slide template. Deadline: EOD Tuesday (5 days). Can we do a first draft by Wed morning?

sam_design: Yep — can pick this up. Do you have a prioritized list of what needs to be included in the kit? :+1:

maria: Priority order: 1) hero social tiles (3 sizes) for X, LinkedIn, Twitter 2) compact one-page benchmark infographic (single PNG + editable Figma) 3) technical diagram showing caching/batching flow (vector SVG) 4) webinar title slide + 2 inside slides (editable). Also need a small animated GIF (300–500KB) for socials.

jordan_pm: Heads up — branding compliance: use current primary palette + accessible color variants. Avoid the old gradient we used last quarter. Also include alt text for the infographic and make sure fonts match our Type Scale v2.

sam_design: Got it. Quick spec draft below — tell me if I missed anything:

```
Assets:
- Hero tiles: 1200x628 (fb/linkedIn), 1080x1080 (instagram), 1200x675 (twitter) -> export @2x PNG + source .fig
- One-pager infographic: 1125x1500 -> export PNG + PDF + .fig
- Technical diagram: SVG + PNG fallback, layered .fig for edits
- Webinar slides: 1920x1080 .fig + export PDF and PPTX
- Animated GIF: 820x312 or 1080x1080, max 500KB, loop 3s
Naming convention: rb_benchmark_<asset>_<variant>_v1.png
Color tokens: use --redwood-primary, --redwood-dark, --neutral-contrast
Typography: Redwood Display for headings, Redwood Text for body (Type Scale v2)
Accessibility: AA contrast for body text, link text min 4.5:1
```

leo_marketing: Can we get a version with reduced copy for paid ads? i.e., hero visuals with a 15-char headline + CTA only. Also need localization placeholders for FR/DE (just text layers separated).

ava_ops: For handoff, we need exported assets into the shared S3 path: s3://redwood-marketing/benchmark-kit/launch-2026/ and the Figma file duplicated into the marketing team project. Also include a tiny readme.md with usage rules and gen-keys for designers.

brandbot: Automated check: color token --redwood-primary passes contrast but --redwood-primary-soft fails for body text at 16px. Recommend alternate token --redwood-secondary for small copy.

sam_design: Thanks — will swap soft token and provide an AA-checked palette. Quick question on illustrations: do we want the new icon set (line + fill) or the legacy flat icons?

maria: New icon set please. Keep illustrations simple — 2-color max to keep file sizes small.

sam_design: Cool. I'll upload a Figma starter file by EOD today with frames for each asset and a checklist. First-draft deliverable timeline: Wed 9:30am — 3 hero tile variants + one-pager + sketch of diagram + 1 slide. Animation draft by Thu. Final pack by next Mon.

jordan_pm: That timeline works. I'll review the one-pager copy and provide short/long headlines for the paid variants by Tue morning.

maria: Perfect. @sam_design, please tag me in the Figma and drop the S3 path when items are exported. Also add a tiny usage permission note for partners: "marketing only; do not modify without approval."

sam_design: Will do. ping me if anyone has mandatory messaging or stats to include.

leo_marketing: I'll drop 3 stat lines (latency/cost/uptime) in the thread by EOD.

ava_ops: FYI — when exporting PPTX include speaker notes section with the webinar TL;DR.

maria: Great — thanks team. :raised_hands:

sam_design: On it. :eyes:
